steps.description: Implement the bootstrap experiment to probe the rigidity of the solution space for small feedforward networks. First, define a linear constraint family (rigid, unique solution) to verify zero-violation is achievable (Step 0). Then, conduct a width-scan bootstrap using scipy.optimize.minimize (L-BFGS-B) to find the minimum hidden width h required to achieve zero-violation (≤1e-3) on holdout points for varying sample counts w. Report N_c(w) trends, training/holdout errors, and compare with theoretical ground truth.
